rule.name: SurrogateSplittingCut
rule.message: This cuts text at a length counted in UTF-16 chars after a check of the same length, so a cut between the two halves of a surrogate pair (an emoji, many CJK characters) leaves a lone surrogate that renders as a replacement character and fails strict UTF-8 encoding. Step back over a high surrogate before cutting (Character.isHighSurrogate(text.charAt(end - 1)) then end--), cut by code point with text.offsetByCodePoints(0, count), or use a BreakIterator for grapheme clusters. Text that is ASCII by construction (ids, hashes, base64) is fine.
